definitions.explanation: A percentage added to a bill at restaurants, hotels, and bars to cover service. Common in higher-end establishments and often shown as a fixed rate such as 10%.

examples.japanese: サービス{料|りょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{別|べつ}→別：01216_betsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦かかります→かかる：00711_kakaru⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦ホテル→ホテル：01027_hoteru⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧サービス{料|りょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{含|ふく}まれている→含む：01982_fukumu⟧。
examples.english: At this hotel the service charge is included.

examples.japanese: ⟦{料金|りょうきん}→料金：03797_ryoukin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧サービス{料|りょう}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{消費税|しょうひぜい}→消費税：04803_shouhizei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{加|くわ}わります→加わる：01940_kuwawaru⟧。
examples.english: A service charge and consumption tax are added to the price.

notes:
Compound of ⟦サービス→サービス：01531_saabisu⟧ (service) + ⟦{料|りょう}→料：28172_ryou⟧ (fee, charge). Japan has no tipping custom, so a service charge added to the bill plays a similar role at upscale venues.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- サービス{料|りょう}⟦{込|こ}み→込み：28615_komi⟧: service charge included
- サービス{料|りょう}⟦{別|べつ}→別：01216_betsu⟧: service charge not included
- サービス{料|りょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦かかる→かかる：00711_kakaru⟧: a service charge applies

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{消費税|しょうひぜい}→消費税：04803_shouhizei⟧: consumption tax — a government tax, not a service fee
- ⟦{手数料|てすうりょう}→手数料：05423_tesuuryou⟧: handling fee; commission — charged for processing, not service
